# Integration identity assets

Selected SVG files from [SVG Logos](https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos), revision `d6960edc1b7309d392c76e40d3a320df7f9ff85c`.
The collection is CC0-1.0; its license is retained beside this file. Brand marks identify
the corresponding providers and do not imply endorsement. Assets are served locally.
